twitter_description: In the dead of night, Ji Ning and Yu Wei face their deepest fears. Plus, a massive lore drop on the Ten Daos of the Three Realms!

lore_anchors.definition: A cultivation partner bound by a shared Dao-heart and lifelong commitment; more than a romantic spouse, often referred to in non-romantic contexts as a cultivation partner.
A powerful being who has comprehended a Grand Dao, ranking above a Celestial Immortal and below a Grand Daoist Patriarch (Daofather) in the immortal hierarchy.
A supreme existence who has mastered a Heavenly Dao and acts as a hegemon within the Three Realms, wielding reality-altering power.
The fundamental, highest-order laws governing the universe, such as the Heavenly Daos of Metal, Water, Life, and Chaos. Mastering one is the path to becoming a Daofather.
The name for a Primal soul manifesting in the form of a tortoise entwined with a serpent, a classic Daoist symbol of a perfected Yin-Yang soul at the Primal stage.
A major law of the universe, superior to a simple Dao and inferior to a Heavenly Dao. Comprehending a Grand Dao is the path to becoming a Pure Yang True Immortal.
The Fiendgod equivalent of a Pure Yang True Immortal; a being of immense power achieved after passing the Heavenly Tribulation on the Proud Fiendgods path.
